traceability.notes: All functional acceptance criteria and listed requirements for 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are implemented and verified by tests. The plugin supports the @supports story-path + REQ-ID format, validates requirements against the correct story files (including multi-story and shared-ID scenarios), maintains full backward compatibility with @story/@req, accepts @supports as satisfying both story and requirement annotations, handles mixed usage within the same comment/file, and reports errors that include the relevant story path. Documentation and migration guidance for @supports are present in the user docs. The Jest test suite, including all tests referencing this story and its requirements, passes successfully. Therefore this story is fully implemented.
